design: Leave-one-campus-out and leave-one-building-system-out values of the held-out, forward and cold-start contrasts and of the Spearman correlation of S with held-out lift; clustered intervals for the difference between the rank correlations of the direct local lift and of the peer evidence score with the 2017 to 2019 lift; the labels, thresholds and eligibility counts of each construction of the gating; the verdicts and route counts with the prior-record-trace gate omitted, fixed, or scored on its frequency-matched reference. No model is fitted.

definitions.removal: all campus-system pairs of the removed campus (as target) or of the removed building system leave the set; verdicts are not recomputed
definitions.stairs_and_conveying_removed: the pairs of stairs (C20) and conveying (D10) removed together
definitions.changes_sign: the value has the opposite sign of the full value
definitions.removes_difference: the value is at most zero for a positive full value (at least zero for a negative one), or undefined because a group is empty
definitions.below_half_of_full: the absolute value is less than half the absolute full value
definitions.two_way_cluster: campuses and building systems among the analysed pairs resampled independently; pair (c, k) enters a_c x b_k times (script 70)
definitions.bootstrap: 5000 replicates per scheme, 95% percentile intervals, seeds [42, 74, scheme]
definitions.omitted: S as the mean of the other four gate scores, prerequisite rule and support level 2/3 unchanged
definitions.trace_pass|caution|fail: the trace gate score replaced by the stated level
definitions.frequency_matched_ratio: trace gate scored on the ratio of the no-antecedent share to its frequency-matched reference (script 61), from the peers' records of the map: pass below 0.5, caution below 1.0, fail at or above 1.0, caution below 30 extreme events; levels set for this analysis
definitions.verdict_depends_on_trace_score: the verdict differs between the trace gate at pass and at fail; only these verdicts can change under any rescoring of that gate

held_out_contrast.label: share of supported minus share of not supported pairs at two-fold, held-out check

held_out_spearman.label: Spearman correlation of S with the held-out lift

forward_contrast.label: forward test, pairs with a peer verdict

forward_contrast_no_verdict_as_not_suppo.label: forward test, pairs without a peer verdict counted as not supported

cold_start_contrast.label: pairs without a direct local evaluation; not supported includes no peer verdict

cold_start_contrast_with_peer_verdict_on.label: pairs without a direct local evaluation, pairs without a peer verdict left out

label_check.statement: every stored label equals the label recomputed with the 75th-percentile thresholds fitted on: C\{c} for pred_single/c; C\{a,b} for pred_pair/a__b; the same sets restricted to rows anchored in 2016 or earlier for the forward-test fits; the prior-year count rule of script 48 carries the labels of pred_single and pred_pair on the same rows

verdict_depends_on_trace_score.definition: verdict with the trace gate at pass differs from the verdict with it at fail
verdict with the trace gate at pass differs from the verdict with it at fail
